_note: Curated disk-major-axis position angles (east of north, degrees). Each object-level PA must be backed by a traceable primary reference in the row `source` (bibcode/DOI/table or stable catalogue); do not add values from uncited guesses. Galaxies absent from this dict fall back to the axisymmetric magnetic-pressure gradient path in src/physics/engine.py and the engine emits 'warn_no_pa'. HyperLEDA pa (Paturel+2003) and NED diameters (object-level bibcodes) are examples of acceptable provenance when they explicitly list PA for that target. NED bulk workflow (2026-05-12): disk PA from NED diameters; kinematic context from NED redshifts (newest bibcodes first, cap 8); luminosity_distance_mpc_planck18 from astropy.cosmology.Planck18 when a published redshift exists (derived, not a NED distance modulus).
_provenance: HyperLEDA (http://leda.univ-lyon1.fr/) — 'pa' column, accessed for the 10 DEFAULT_CONTROL_GALAXIES listed in src/pipeline/constants.py. | NED/IPAC via astroquery.ipac.ned (2026-05-12, UTC workflow); name candidates mirror sources/ned/ned_alias_map.json. Derived luminosity distances: Planck18 (astropy).

<sparc_name>.position_angle_deg: float (east of north, deg) — required for pipeline PA overlay
<sparc_name>.source: string — catalogue / NED provenance (read by SparcMorphologyProvider as position_angle_source)
<sparc_name>.ned_kinematic_measurements_by_recency: list[{refcode, published_redshift, published_redshift_uncertainty, published_velocity_kms, published_velocity_uncertainty_kms, luminosity_distance_mpc_planck18}] — audit only; SPARC D_Mpc remains canonical in the engine
